mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code_change_batch (workspace_id, message_id, `desc`, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, created_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{messageId}, #{desc}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, message_id, `desc`, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, created_at FROM code_change_batch WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
